METALWORK — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Metalwork related businesses, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork related businesses.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork related businesses.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork related businesses.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork related businesses.

2. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

4. When learning Heat treatment of steel, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Heat treatment of steel.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Heat treatment of steel.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Heat treatment of steel.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Heat treatment of steel.

5. When learning Career Opportunities in Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.

6. When learning Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

8. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

11. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.

12. When learning Forging, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Forging.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Forging.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Forging.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Forging.

13. When learning Surface Finishing Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Finishing Processes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Surface Finishing Processes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Finishing Processes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Finishing Processes.

14. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 1.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.

15. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Assembly Drawings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Gas Welding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Forging and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Surface Finishing Processes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Project 2 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
